description: This file defines a React component 'MessageActions' for rendering action buttons (edit, copy, pin, delete, resend, stop) related to chat messages in a chat UI. It includes functions for handling message operations and UI interactions, utilizing external icons, localization, and chat store utilities.

classes.name: MessageActionsProps
classes.description: Props interface for the MessageActions React component, including message data, UI flags, and callback functions.

methods.name: genActionsShema
methods.description: Generates an array of action button configurations for message operations such as edit, copy, pin, delete, resend, and stop.

methods.name: deleteMessage
methods.description: Removes a message from the current chat session by message ID.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles message deletion triggered by user action.

methods.name: onResend
methods.description: Handles resending a message, including finding related messages, deleting original, and re-submitting user input.

methods.name: onPinMessage
methods.description: Pins a message to the session context and shows a toast with an option to set a prompt modal.

methods.name: onUserStop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing message response via ChatControllerPool.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Allows editing a message's content via a prompt, updating the message in the session.

methods.name: onCopy
methods.description: Copies message text content to clipboard.
